name: aep
description: Plan governed work in the AEP artifact store and deliver it in reviewed waves.

interface.longDescription: Create and review governed planning artifacts, decompose work, reverse-engineer an existing repository, then scope stories, coordinate isolated implementation units and route each result through adversarial review, all through the canonical AEP command.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use aep to plan this work in the artifact store or deliver it in a reviewed wave.
